capabilities: Browse vault folders as a card-grid dashboard
Assign custom banner images to folders and notes
Display frontmatter metadata on library cards
Navigate between subfolders with back-button navigation
disambiguation: Not an image gallery; it renders folders and notes as cards, with banner images used as decorations.
extras: The preview screenshot referenced in the README is not included in the text.
problem: Obsidian's file browsing is list-based, with no visual card-grid way to browse folders as a library of resources.
summary: Folder gallery view that renders vault directories as a navigable grid of banner cards with frontmatter metadata and task checkboxes.
